# Nectar

> Nectar is a Go bridge that connects Feishu / Lark, DingTalk, and Telegram to local coding-agent CLIs (Codex, Claude Code, Cursor Agent, OpenCode, or Pi). It runs as a background service, keeps sessions continuous, streams progress, and supports scheduled tasks.

## Agent installation

- [Agent install guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zhouyg1992/nectar/main/AGENT_INSTALL.md): deterministic, non-interactive installation instructions for AI coding agents.
- [installer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zhouyg1992/nectar/main/install.sh): release installer with checksum verification.
